messages.author: 4499da98fc95d8eb
messages.subject: testthat issue with devtools / RStudio
parts:
I'm trying to get using the testthat package through devtools and RStudio, but have encountered a problem.

When I run devtools::test() at the command line, the test fails because it can't find the function test_dir() from testthat.  

Error in force(code) : could not find function "test_dir"

If I load the package testthat, then there's no problem, but shouldn't test() check this itself?  It seems to check whether or not testthat is installed but not whether it is actually loaded.

This means that when I try to use the Cmd + Shift + T shortcut in RStudio to run the tests, it also fails in the same way, and this is regardless of whether I load testthat at the command line first or not.  I wondered if this is meant to be dealt with by the 
library(testthat)
line in the file tests/testthat.R which was automatically generated (but apparently it doesn't work for me).

Any ideas what I'm doing wrong here?  I'm using RStudio 0.98.1062 on OS X 10.6.8.
